findings: Supported Poky 6.0.2 linux-yocto do_compile held the eight-logical-CPU host at 99.8601% trimmed-mean utilization for a complete 360-second window after a ten-second warmup, in an isolated offline build directory.

The v0.1.61 ASCII-optimized daemon plus attached client consumed 0.9777% of one logical CPU; input p95 was 5.8214 ms. Cancellation acknowledgement was 0.4570 ms, fresh attach 26.5856 ms, and all continuity checks passed. Headroom remains limited.

Pre-optimization 120- and 360-second captures failed at 1.0170% and 1.0065%; both are retained under artifacts/performance/logger. The source patch preserves all performance thresholds and fixes only measured redundant ASCII segmentation.
At 90% or greater host utilization during live work, presentation coalesces to 1 Hz while input and resize stay immediate; below saturation ordinary activity remains 4 Hz.
